envelope.description: Entity deletes clean export_names; the repository delete can return incoming edges to pending

body.title: Entity deletes clean export_names; the repository delete can return incoming edges to pending
body.summary: In src/db/entities.ts detachDeleteEntitiesInTxn removes every export_names entry keyed by each deleted u64 in the same transaction; deleteEntitiesForRepo (:560-583) gains { returnIncomingToPending } which, before the delete, writes every relationship another repository holds into the repository's entities back as a pending row of the holder awaiting the entity id, in one transaction with the counts, and returns { returnedToPending }. Anchors: deleteEntitiesForRepo is at src/db/entities.ts:560-583 and reaches detachDeleteEntitiesInTxn (:1099-1135) through detachDeleteEntities (:1087); the whole-file replacement calls it at :485. Depends on t3 for writing returned relationships as counted pending rows; export_names exists from t1.
acceptanceChecks: Re-indexing then deleting a barrel leaves no export_names entry under its old u64
With the option, a hand-written edge from repository A into B is a pending row of A awaiting B's entity after B's delete; a forced failure leaves both B's rows and A's edge untouched
Without the option the delete behaves as today

tests.name: src/db/__tests__/delete-entities-by-id.test.ts: barrel re-index and delete leave no export_names entry under the old u64 (mutation: cleanup removed)
src/db/__tests__/entities-return-to-pending.test.ts: hand-written cross-repository edge returned to pending; forced failure leaves both sides
